scope: Complete-method and official-code grounding for missingness-shift prediction

sources.title: MIRRAMS: Learning Robust Tabular Models under Unseen Missingness Shifts
sources.mechanism: mutual-information robustness conditions and loss terms intended to remove dependence on unstable missingness information
sources.limitation: No author repository was verified in this scan; abstract-level claims are not an implementation record.

sources.title: StableMiss and StableMiss+: Prediction with Incomplete Data under Agnostic Mask Distribution Shift
sources.evidence: paper record plus official repository README and file listing
sources.mechanism: double parameterization with sample reweighting/decorrelation; StableMiss+ preserves feature-feature correlations while removing mask-mask and feature-mask correlations
sources.license_status: No license was visible in the repository page snapshot; verify before vendoring.

sources.title: NeuMiss networks: differentiable programming for supervised learning with missing values
sources.evidence: NeurIPS paper, official repository README, and repository file/license listing
sources.mechanism: truncated Neumann-series approximation with entrywise multiplication by the missingness indicator

sources.title: Robust prediction under missingness shifts
sources.evidence: arXiv HTML paper with theorem, estimator descriptions, and experimental setup
sources.mechanism: Bayes predictor invariance under ignorable missingness shifts; non-ignorable shifts can change the target predictor
sources.limitation: No official code repository was verified in this scan.

sources.title: Model Selection under Missing-Data Distribution Shift: Rank Reversals and Reliability
sources.evidence: official repository README, protocol manifest and license listing
sources.mechanism: model-selection transport under source/target missingness mechanisms, measuring rank reversals, winner persistence and target-oracle regret
sources.scale: 19 datasets, 5x5 mechanisms, 22 pipelines, 5 seeds, 2,850 jobs, 52,250 evaluations
sources.data_boundary: raw third-party datasets are not redistributed

next_test.question: Does selective decorrelation that preserves feature-feature correlations help when training is MCAR and final masks are value-dependent or grouped?
next_test.development: One fresh seed for implementation agreement only; no confirmatory claim.
next_test.confirmatory_data: Separate fresh seeds and an untouched transfer dataset; do not reuse the prior three-seed fixture.
next_test.falsifier: No gain over strongest matched control, or gain disappears when the held-out mask mechanism changes.
